selector.rationale: New onset of fever, generalized weakness, productive cough, and radiographic findings of reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation are more consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia in an HIV-positive patient with a low CD4 count

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Although toxoplasmosis was previously diagnosed and treated, the new respiratory symptoms and radiographic findings are not typical of toxoplasmosis

rejected.label: HIV-associated immune suppression
rejected.why: This is a underlying condition rather than a specific diagnosis for the current symptoms

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: There is limited evidence to support this diagnosis, and the clinical presentation is not typical of CMV infection
